people.text: Ethan wants to know about environmental organisations around the world. He's interested in doing a project at home on energy production, and wants recommendations for other websites with up-to-date information on new research.
Mario is interested in how the way he gets to work affects the environment, and wants ideas to reduce any negative effects. He'd like to meet local people who share his interest in the environment.
Sylvia is keen to know what she can do with items she doesn't need, rather than throw them away. She'd like the opportunity to ask environmental experts about their work.
Declan wants to know where to find clothes produced without damaging the environment. He'd like to learn about recycling processes, and see how recycling is done internationally.
Tasha wants to help her family save energy, and get a basic introduction to studying the environment for a college project. She'd also like to buy something created from recycled items.

items.label: A
items.title: futurenow.org
items.text: Find answers here about how much energy is used around the planet. And if you're planning a journey, put in your route to compare the energy used by different types of transport, and choose the one that's best for the environment.

items.label: B
items.title: ourworld.org
items.text: This site lists the best places in the world to find the latest results of scientific studies on issues affecting the environment. Or if you prefer working things out for yourself, there are experiments to do like making your own power using sunlight! You'll also find information on groups all over the planet working to protect the environment.

items.label: C
items.title: cleanplanet.org
items.text: Discover how waste plastic, glass and metal are turned into new products, and watch clips showing different methods used around the world. There's also a section about how much attention various fashion companies pay to their effect on the environment. Use it to keep up with new trends!

items.label: D
items.title: globaleco.org
items.text: This site explores the importance of energy in our daily lives, and also different ways of generating it without using oil or gas, for example by using wind power instead. There are links to UK companies that use these renewable energies, so you can find out more about what they do.

items.label: E
items.title: eco.org
items.text: Contact others who also care about environmental issues and find information about international groups; search for one to join in your area. You can also find out if your choice of transport damages the planet. If so, try the easy changes to your routine suggested here.

items.label: F
items.title: planetmatters.org
items.text: Learn about what top scientists involved in research to protect our planet do day to day, as well as about their latest discoveries. There's a message board so you can post questions to them – you'll always get a quick reply. There's also a recycling section – find different uses for things that you might otherwise put in the bin.

items.label: G
items.title: worldaware.org
items.text: Most people want to know what they can do to help protect our world. This site has everything you need to know about recycling: why it's important around the world, and how to get rid of items safely in your local area without harming the environment.

items.label: H
items.title: oneworld.org
items.text: There's lots of environmental information here, whether you're just starting to explore the subject or wanting to find out about the latest research. Gifts are on sale, too, made from objects and materials that are often thrown out – treat yourself and help the planet! There's also a useful guide on using less electricity at home – reduce those bills!

explanations.6: Ethan 想了解全球环保组织，做能源生产项目并找最新研究的网站推荐。B 网站 “ourworld.org” 列出了全球环保组织，有科学研究最新结果和实验，符合需求。“This site lists the best places in the world to find the latest results of scientific studies on issues affecting the environment... information on groups all over the planet working to protect the environment.” 对应 “environmental organisations... energy production... new research”。
explanations.7: Mario 关心通勤对环境的影响，想减少负面影响并结识当地环保人士。E 网站 “eco.org” 能联系环保人士，查找当地可加入的组织，还有改变通勤方式的建议，符合要求。“Contact others who also care about environmental issues and find information about international groups; search for one to join in your area. You can also find out if your choice of transport damages the planet.” 对应 “reduce any negative effects... meet local people who share his interest”。
explanations.8: Sylvia 想知道如何处理不需要的物品，而不是扔掉，还想有机会询问环保专家的工作。F 网站 “planetmatters.org” 有回收利用的部分，教人们如何利用可能扔进垃圾桶的东西，还有留言板可以向专家提问，符合需求。“There's a message board so you can post questions to them... recycling section – find different uses for things that you might otherwise put in the bin.” 对应 “what she can do with items she doesn't need... ask environmental experts about their work”。
explanations.9: Declan 想找不破坏环境生产的衣服，了解回收过程和国际回收情况。C 网站 “cleanplanet.org” 展示了塑料、玻璃和金属等废物如何变成新产品，还有关于时尚公司对环境影响的关注，符合要求。“Discover how waste plastic, glass and metal are turned into new products... a section about how much attention various fashion companies pay to their effect on the environment.” 对应 “clothes produced without damaging the environment... recycling processes... internationally”。
explanations.10: Tasha 想帮助家人节能，为大学项目获取环境研究的基本介绍，还想买用回收物品制作的东西。H 网站 “oneworld.org” 有节能指南、环境信息，还有用回收材料制作的礼品出售，符合需求。“There's lots of environmental information here... useful guide on using less electricity at home... Gifts are on sale, too, made from objects and materials that are often thrown out.” 对应 “save energy... basic introduction to studying the environment... buy something created from recycled items”。
